decisions.reason: The existing requirement already specifies an NTC input on J_BAT; selecting a three-pin JST-PH connector preserves that safety behavior without changing its state.
The battery connector family, pitch, and pinout do not change the ESP32 sleep policy or wake sources.
The battery connector change does not alter charge-status indication through the SK6812 LED chain.
Changing the battery connector specification does not alter the required TVS ESD protection.
The battery connector pinout does not change the software-controlled 5V sensor rail or its operating pattern.
The connector specification does not explicitly change the established battery-connector location, orientation, spacing, mounting-hole clearance, or board form-factor constraints.
The source selects the battery connector interface but does not change the existing component-sourceability rules or explicitly extend their USB-connector context.
